environment.description: EC2 instance (m5.large) running Amazon Linux 2, application deployed in Docker container with custom OCI runtime seccomp profile loaded via --security-opt seccomp=/etc/docker/seccomp-legacy-monolith.json. The profile is derived from the default docker profile but with additional syscall restrictions: execve, execveat, ptrace, process_vm_readv, process_vm_writev, socket, connect, bind, listen, accept, accept4, socketpair are all set to SCMP_ACT_ERRNO (EPERM). The container uses --network=none and communicates only via a pre-established Unix domain socket pair inherited from the parent process (created before container start via socketpair(AF_UNIX) and passed as fd 3). The Flask app is patched at container entry to use the inherited fd via a custom WSGI adapter (uwsgi --socket fd://3). Container runs as uid 65534 (nobody) with no capabilities (--cap-drop=ALL).

config.communication: inherited unix socket fd from parent (pre-fork socketpair)
config.reverse_proxy: parent process haproxy on host handles TLS and forwards via unix socket
